jobs.title: PCA/CNA Needed
jobs.summary: Full- and part-time in-home care starting at $19.25/hour, with particular need for Friday-Sunday availability. Duties include assisting with activities of daily living, bathing, hygiene, meal preparation, mobility, social supervision, homemaking, life-coach and companion support. Requires current CNA/PCA certification (waiver or training may be available), compassion, ability to lift 50 lb, a driver's license, insurance and reliable transportation.
